study.question: Can exposing a residual historical-feedback/value association through the existing task-specific adapters improve click AUC beyond the current gated-duplicate incumbent at unchanged learned capacity, rather than merely changing support or exposing an arbitrary partition?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: candidate.py uses uniform block pooling for the primary readout and feedback-stratified pooling for auxiliary readouts. Its residual inputs encode target match and ordinal moments; the fifth direction merely duplicates target match under a gate. A within-block feedback indicator/value covariance may expose a complementary readout to the primary task through the existing task-specific adapter. This is an accessibility hypothesis about existing authorized information, not a claim of new raw information. Local evidence is mixed: direct compressed task routing g0-r0006-compressed_task reached 0.6591942389399411, below the 0.660646940486458 stronger frozen source. Target-match detail later reached 0.6630190236433535. The match-by-order candidate g0-r0016-joint_ordered (0.6656437663030599) lost to duplicate_match (0.6657390847414351); block-energy-local (0.6655283136366961) lost to available_norm (0.6658605169646938). Cubic_ordered (0.665704885611003) exceeded cubic_scrambled (0.6653239215664951) but lost to cubic_gated_duplicate (0.6659300360390669), while cubic_bridge exactly reproduced 0.6658605169646938. Thus more ordinal detail and local match reweighting are unsuccessful branches, not mechanism confirmation. The latest knowledge-usage record declares external methods considered rather than executed; its cubic interpretation is superseded by the now-available negative replacement outcome. Existing source and incumbent gains are single-seed validation observations, not repeated support. Prediction: aligned historical feedback projected off the existing coefficient span will outperform matched rotated and duplicate replacements and the exact incumbent bridge; otherwise useful complementarity for this implementation is unsupported.

nearest_work.difference: Exact available ancestor source verified at SHA256 6b404ecb67390cd4bc5b0fba904eef689e61aea7679dafee128e0a0b41395b01. Replace its redundant fifth coefficient direction only; preserve all learned modules and four old summaries. The new bridge returns its exact expression.

This prior negative trial used task-specific scoring of compressed slots and changed scorer width/readout. Here the successful source scorer and gradient ownership are retained; feedback/value residuals enter already-existing task-specific adapters.

Archived exact-version primary text, especially lines120-126, describes target-adaptive local activation and weighted history pooling. The local implementation inherits that scorer and Dice, while adding a fixed masked residual feedback coefficient. Neither exact DIN reproduction nor originality of the extension is claimed.

Pinned benchmark forward123-170 inspected: lines136-139 initialize learned task sequence hubs by action-mask pooled projections, then categorical/sequence/task tokens undergo repeated interaction. This proposal uses one fixed union-feedback residual direction, a valid-rank alignment control, and existing adapters; no learned hubs or broadcast stack. This is a difference from the benchmark implementation, not a verified difference from the original INFNet paper.
Original paper link resolved; detailed authorized text unavailable and explicit fallback read. Original-method priority/reproduction claims remain unverified.

Primary benchmark section2.3 lines17,31,33 distinguishes flatten-history mixing, hub interaction and cross-attention/field-specific layers. None of those complete architectures is reproduced by this capacity-fixed residual replacement.

inherited_components: Entire learned architecture and literal architecture configuration of g0-r0019-cubic_gated_duplicate, except the added nonlearned feedback_extension mode.
Ten blocks of ten supplied history positions; uniform and union-feedback strata; count-weighted unnormalized target/action-aware scorer; primary-owned scorer/item/action training paths.
Target-match count features; centered target match, within-block ordinal, coarse linear and quadratic value summaries; inherited original fifth eligibility and scale builders.
Four task-specific width-16 residual adapters, source-equivalent zero final-layer initialization, unchanged embedding/tower allocation and source RNG preservation.
Frozen host four-task sum-BCE training and all sample-information/resource/scoring contracts.
study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules add only a parameter-free fifth-summary selector. Set h to the supplied history-masked union of cart/fav/buy historical masks. Within each ten-position block, center h over valid events. Project h off the centered local ordinal and the target-match direction after the latter is projected off local ordinal, using the existing two-sweep FP32 residual helper. Block centering makes the resulting vector orthogonal to all block-constant coefficients, including coarse linear/quadratic summaries. Build a second residual from a deterministic half-cycle rotation of h among the valid positions of each block; it preserves each block feedback count even for noncontiguous masks. Restrict both and the duplicate control to identical support (incumbent norm2 and position norm2 >1e-10; both new residual norm2 >1e-8), and normalize both to the actual incumbent fifth coefficient norm. Contract with the same item/action value vectors and inherited sqrt(valid-history-count) denominator. Select aligned, rotated, common-gate incumbent duplicate, or exact incumbent bridge. Every arm computes every alternative; no learned modules, randomness, loss hooks or extra data are added. The first four summary coefficients, task adapters, gradient detaches, towers and scorer remain unchanged. All use task routing; this round does not re-establish the independent value of task conditioning. The scope is feedback/value alignment accessible to the primary readout; auxiliary stratified pooling already contains overlapping information. Ordinals are array positions, not elapsed time. Eligibility may be rare; no fresh data inspection or gate prevalence measurement is available in this coding phase. Novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Primary: full-population validation click AUC feedback_aligned > feedback_rotated and > feedback_gated_duplicate, as well as > feedback_bridge and both frozen source bests (0.660646940486458 and 0.660163362657485). A result below the incumbent cannot support useful replacement even if it beats rotation.
The bridge should reproduce incumbent predictions/AUC for the frozen seed, input and source recipe; extra coefficient construction increases compute without changing the bridge prediction operator.

All four arms have identical parameters (expected total32129765, dense336549), initialization, original summaries and auxiliary gradient ownership. Common-gate replacements have equal coefficient norm per sample, exact zeros at masked positions and zero block sums before BF16 value contraction.

The mechanism can act directly only on common-gate supported histories. Predeclare the existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 length bins for reporting with samples/positives/negatives; mixed-feedback eligibility/composition slices require authorized host diagnostics and counts before interpretation. Training effects may still alter predictions on ineligible/empty histories.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, measured wall/GPU time, peak memory and inference throughput/p50/p95 latency. A primary gain with auxiliary degradation is a tradeoff, not universal multi-task improvement. Parameter matching does not establish equal compute.
falsifiers: Aligned does not exceed both same-gate controls, or cannot exceed the exact incumbent bridge: useful feedback/value complementarity is unsupported for this implementation.
Rotated matches/exceeds aligned: semantic alignment is not isolated; arbitrary partitioning, conditioning, redundancy or seed effects remain adequate explanations.
Only the gated duplicate improves: an eligibility effect is sufficient, without support for the new coefficient information.

Bridge diverges materially from archived incumbent despite identical source/input/protocol hashes, or host forward/backward/masking/gradient checks fail: execution integrity must be repaired before predictive interpretation.
An apparent gain vanishes in paired seed repetition or is explained by measured extra compute relative to alternatives: no repeated-support or efficiency claim.

Degeneracy gates admit almost no examples or FP32/BF16 coefficient errors break intended orthogonality/norm bounds: applicability or numerical implementation fails, not the general role of historical feedback.
alternative_explanations: The fifth channel is redundant but changes optimization geometry; common norm does not equalize learned feature covariance or conditioning.
Additional gating is a proxy for history length, feedback prevalence or target-match availability. The duplicate control isolates their aggregate gating effect, not separate gate causes.
Feedback-union masks lose individual task distinctions; rare auxiliary signals or inherited gradient blocking may make this representation ineffective.

The auxiliary pooling path already exposes feedback means, and action embeddings carry feedback identity; the new coefficient may be redundant with the full model even though it is outside the old coefficient span.
Many earlier adaptive validation comparisons and one frozen seed create selection bias. No significance, repeated support or holdout generalization is inferred from a single candidate win.

Official_offline delayed feedback and whole-window preprocessing are inherited assumptions; auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within24h rather than advertisement-specific conversions. DMR author README confirms a different behavior-field schema and cannot justify importing event-level item-conversion semantics.

Raw parquet/checksum verification and loader execution are host prerequisites reported in the frozen contract, not newly reproduced here. Missing local data/torch access is an execution boundary and not scientific counterevidence.
